text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

CHINA, Oct 5 - Keelung - four vessels anchored, berthing delays coal 4 days, steel 2 days, iron ore 3 days. No delays for grain. Kaohsiung - five vessels anchored, berthing delays grain 1 day, iron/coal 3 days (csc berth), coal/scrap 1 day (public berth), steel 3 days. Taichung - four vessels anchored, berthing delays iron ore/coal/steel/others 1 day, no delays for grain/scrap. Oct 7 Kaohsiung - 71 vessels in port of which 12 containers, 9 tankers, 1 grain, 1 other bulker, 34 general cargo, 14 at buoys. No vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no berthing delays. Keelung - 29 vessels in port of which 14 containers, 1 tanker, 11 other bulker, 3 general cargo, 1 container vessel waiting at outer anchorage, 1 day's average berthing delay expected.

INDIA, Oct 8 - Bombay - no labour problems. Three vessels loading at berth, 21 discharging, 5 discharging at anchorage, 7 waiting at anchorage to load, 22 to discharge. 1 bunkering, 11 under repairs, 2 awaiting orders. Delays container vessels 3-4 days, bulkers 4-5 days, general cargo 5-6 days. Calcutta - seven loading at berth, 9 discharging, none anchored, 1 bunkering, 18 due of which 2 coking coal, 12 products tankers, 4 containers. Cochin - no labour problems. Vessels due/delays 1 container loader/discharger, 1 breakbulk loader, 1 mop/dap/urea discharger, up to 1 days delay, 1 rock phosphate/sulphur discharger, 3-5 days, 1 general cargo (steel/grain/coal/sugar) up to 1 day, 1 scrap depending on receiver's readiness to receive direct delivery, 1 crude discharger, 1-2 days delay, 2 products tankers, no delay, 2 tankers waiting at anchor. 2 vessels at shipyard drydock. Mormugao - working normally. Two vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging, 3 loading at anchorage, 2 waiting to load, 1 to discharge, 5 under repairs/dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders, 13 due of which 1 containers, 1 petroleum, 1 phosphoric acid, up to 1 days delay, 10 ore vessels, 3-4 days delay. Kandla - one loading at berth, 6 discharging, 2 discharging at anchorage, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 4 to discharge. 4 tankers, 17 tankers waiting. Lightening delays rice/sulphur/g-blocks/scrap 5-6 days, pipes 4-5 days, TEUs 2-3 days. Mangalore - no labour problems. One vessel bunkering, 1 under arrest, 3 due to load granite blocks, 5 to load iron ore concentrate/pellets, up to 1 days delay. Madras - no labour problems. Six loading at berth, 9 discharging, 1 under repairs/ dry-docked, 34 due, delays coal/coke 3-4 days fertiliser/others 2-3 days, scrap 4-5 days, no delays iron ore/containers. Jawaharlal Nehru no labour problems. Four discharging at berth, 2 fertiliser/raw materials, 2 tankers/iron ore 1 tanker/iron ore waiting at anchorage to discharge, 3 fertiliser/raw materials to load 3 fertiliser/raw materials due, 15-20 days delay expected. 2 tankers/iron ore due, 2-3 days delay. Paradip working normally. Four loading at berth, 2 discharging, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 to discharge. Vessels due 3 coal, 1 iron ore, 2 days delay, 1 food, 1 chemicals, no delays. Other delays chrome/oil 4 days, fertiliser 10 days, oil 4 days. Tuticorin no labour problems. Five vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging, 1 waiting to load, 1 to discharge, 6 due, up to 1 days delay. Visakhapatnam six loading at berth, 7 discharging, 1 waiting at anchorage to load at inner harbour, 7 to discharge, 1 under repairs. Vessels due 1 export molasses, 4 import coal, 3 import rock phosphate (1-2 days delay), 1 export granite (3-4 days), 1 containers (up to 1 day), 1 import d.b. magnesite (7-8 days).

S.Korea, Oct 8 - Inchon - 81 vessels in port (47 berthed, 34 anchored) of which berthed 10 logs, 6 general cargo, 5 coils, 4 containers, 3 pig iron, 3 steel plates, 2 steel, 2 rapemeal, 2 cars, 2 scrap, 1 timber, 1 cement, 1 corn, 1 pulp, 1 ingots, 1 plywood, 1 wheat, 1 maize. Anchored 9 logs, 5 general cargo, 3 corn, 3 cars, 3 containers, 2 soymeal, 1 tapioca, 1 copra, 1 pulp, 1 plywood, 1 steel, 1 molasses, 1 oak, 1 wheat pellets, 1 feed meal. Approx 3-4 days delay expected. Busan - 168 vessels in port (50 berthed, 118 anchored including 59 laid up) of which berthed 35 general cargo, 8 containers, 4 scrap, 3 coal. 59 awaiting berths, 2-3 days delay. Pohang - 15 vessels in port (all berthed) of which discharging 2 oil, 1 coal, 1 iron ore, 1 coils, 1 wire rods, 1 chrome, 1 billets, 1 plate. 6 steel vessels loading. No delays. Ulsan - 29 in port (22 berthed, 7 anchored), of which discharging 2 styrene monomer, 1 coal, 1 feed meal, 1 mono ethyl glycol, 1 fertiliser, 1 sugar, 1 coils, 1 chemicals, 1 zinc concentrates, 1 woodchips, 1 crude, 1 propane, 1 kerosene. Vessels loading 4 resin, 2 ammonium sulphate, 1 chemicals, 1 naphtha. 7 awaiting berths, approx 3-5 days delay but 15 days for feed meal. Masan - four in port, all berthed, of which discharging 2 steel scrap, 1 logs. 1 container vessel loading. No delays expected.

Malaysia, Oct 9 - Port Kelang north port container berths 4 vessels berthed, 3 sailing, 1 berthing today. Deep draft conventional wharves 4 berthed, 2 berthing today, 4 waiting, 3-4 days waiting time expected. Dry bulk terminal 1 berthed, 2 waiting, 6-7 days waiting time. Wharf 25 closed for repairs. West port 4 conventional vessels berthed, 2 cement carriers berthed and discharging, 1 days waiting time expected.

PAKISTAN, Oct 7 - Karachi one rice vessel loading at berth, 2 vessels loading/discharging containers, 13 vessels discharging at berth (general cargo, dap, iron, sugar, containers, palm oil) 1 Clinker vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 15 vessels waiting to discharge (general cargo, containers, vehicles, sugar, oil, fertiliser) 1 Vessel awaiting orders, 11 due with up to 2 days delay expected.

PHILIPPINES, Oct 8 - Manila south harbour 11 vessels discharging at berth 8 discharging at anchorage, 9 waiting at outer anchorage to discharge, 7 Others. Average waiting times vessels with draft less than 8 metres and loa less than 130 metres - 1 day, draft greater than 9 metres and loa greater then 140 metres - 1-2 days. Occasional monsoon rains.

SINGAPORE, Oct 7 - Tanjong Pagar container terminal 7 vessels berthed. Keppel terminal 13 container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang 10 container/general vessels berthed. Sembawang terminal 3 general cargo vessels berthed. Jurong port 1 bulk/steel/general cargo berthed. Oil terminals/ sbm buoys 25 tankers berthed. Minimal berthing delays at all terminals/ports/buoys. No rain expected for next few days.
THAILAND, Oct 4 - Bangkok - 120 vessels in port of which 6 containers, 114 other bulkers/general cargo vessels. 4 Vessels waiting at outernchorage. No berthing delays expected.
